messages:
rachel_dev: quick idea for mid-stream graceful downgrade + cache eviction: introduce a stream-epoch + commit-token handshake so edge can tell upstream when it's safe to free per-request KV state. avoids re-emitting or double-accounting when we flip to compressed/delta mode.

omar_khan: sounds promising. can you sketch what the epoch/commit semantics look like? how do we prevent race windows where both backends think they own the tail?

rachel_dev: sketch: each streaming session has an epoch counter (monotonic). when edge decides to downgrade (eg stalled, tenant budget, overload), it requests an epoch flush: upstream writes a Commit-Token for the last consumed offset and replies ACK. after ACK, edge may switch to fallback variant for future fragments. important: fallback cannot re-emit any offset < commit-offset.

lee_ops: important constraints: 1) do not re-batch already-dispatched fragments, 2) minimal extra RTT, 3) cheap checks for high QPS. we can't afford synchronous consensus per fragment.

vika_research: model/state problem: small-quant fallback may not share KV layout; need a way to translate commit-offset -> semantic cursor so fallback can resume coherently (or fall back to delta-compress where we only send compressed diffs).

omar_khan: propose headers we can use:

```
X-Redwood-Stream-Epoch: 7
X-Redwood-Commit-Token: s-7-00001234
X-Redwood-Commit-Offset: 3245
X-Redwood-Downgrade-Mode: delta-compress | short-context | cache-prefix
X-Redwood-Epoch-Requested-At: 1797654330
Hedging-Safe: true|false
```

rachel_dev: semantics: 1) Epoch advance is initiated by edge with Epoch-Requested; upstream responds with Commit-Token and last-offset it has safely persisted. 2) Edge uses Commit-Token as canonical checkpoint; any fallback must accept a Commit-Token to resume beyond that offset. 3) If fallback can't accept token translation, it must operate in read-only degraded mode (no re-emit).

lee_ops: reconciliation idea: make commit acknowledgements idempotent and cheap by letting upstream keep a small in-memory epoch->offset map keyed by Commit-Token; edge caches token locally until session end or TTL. reduces RPC chatter.

vika_research: telemetry hooks: emit stream_epoch.{requested,ack,switched} with fields: tenant, stream_id, epoch, commit_token, commit_offset, reason. helps perf/incident Triage.

omar_khan: billing: require checkpointed billing boundary. include header X-Redwood-Billing-Checkpoint: <commit_token> and only bill tokens after that. avoids double-billing when a fallback wins.

rachel_dev: downlink/backpressure: if upstream is overloaded, edge can advertise a Downgrade-Mode=delta-compress and the client receives a progress trailer hint. clients should handle a terminal trailer indicating epoch switch and a resume policy.

lee_ops: edge behavior on stall: ACTIVE -> EPOCH_REQUESTED -> EPOCH_ACKED -> SWITCH_PENDING -> SWITCHED. until SWITCHED, keep streaming from incumbent. when SWITCHED, downstream gets a short trailer: {commit_token, last_offset, new_mode}.

vika_research: hedging & side-effects: hedging across epochs is dangerous. require Hedging-Safe: true to permit duplicate-side-effect hedges. otherwise, only non-duplicating downgraded variants allowed. add Idempotency-Envelope header for requests that may touch external systems.

omar_khan: test matrix we need:
- stall -> epoch checkpoint -> delta-compress switch (verify no double-emit)
- epoch ACK lost -> retry path with idempotent commit-token handshake
- fallback variant can't accept token -> read-only degraded path + billing check
- hedging-safe false but fallback attempted -> should fallback only if variant is single-path

rachel_dev: ownership: i'll draft RFC follow-up with concrete header examples and state diagram. omar/lee can prototype a lightweight epoch map & TTL policy. vika will add telemetry + eval experiments on delta-compress quality.

ci-bot: tests/stream-epoch: added 4 integration tests, branch=feature/stream-epoch-checkpoint @1797654340 :white_check_mark:

lee_ops: small implementation notes: - keep commit-token size small (<= 32 bytes) - commit-token rotation TTL 30s by default - make epoch-requests best-effort under load (fall back to degrade-mode if no ack within threshold)

vika_research: client SDK: add onEpochSwitch(callback) and expose commitToken/lastOffset in trailers so app-level reconcilers can decide to request partial rehydration. doc note too.

omar_khan: final thought: this reduces KV pressure and gives us clean billing & observability for midstream transitions. the complexity is non-trivial but contained to edge/upstream handshake + fallback variants. good win for production stability.

rachel_dev: thanks all. action items: 1) rachel: RFC draft, 2) omar+lee: prototype epoch map & perf run, 3) vika: telemetry + client SDK hooks, 4) write integration tests (owners: lee). I'll circulate a strawman doc by EOD tomorrow.
